svg.text: Deck-solar boat or Wave Glider: which goes further per day? (2024)
orange: 4 m solar boat, 30 W payload; blue: 2015 Wave Glider, best state; darker = bigger ratio (to 4x)
B = boat sustains more km/day; W = Wave Glider plans more. Sun: NASA POWER daily all-sky; waves: ERA5 (Copernicus, via Open-Meteo).
Calm-water boat, energy-neutral at the month's mean sun; grey = sea ice. research/marine-hull, milestone 6z.
